description: This file defines a React functional component named 'Email' that manages user email notification preferences, including muting sign-in and marketing emails. It fetches user settings, updates them, and displays toggles with conditional content based on feature availability and subscription status.

methods.name: updateSetting
methods.description: Asynchronously updates a user setting and handles errors by alerting the user; returns true if successful, false otherwise.

methods.name: loadSettings
methods.description: Fetches user settings on component load and updates local state; handles loading state and errors.

methods.name: toggleMuteSignInEmails
methods.description: Toggles the mute sign-in emails setting and updates the user setting accordingly.

methods.name: toggleMuteMarketingEmails
methods.description: Toggles the mute marketing emails setting and updates the user setting accordingly.
